name: singlet_communication_spatial_lr_scoring
title: Spatial ligand-receptor scoring
description: Scores ligand-receptor pairs between spatially neighbouring spots or cells and writes per-pair scores, p-values and FDR q-values, with optional per-spot scores. The default spatialdm_z is an analytic bivariate Moran z-score that needs no permutations; commot needs commot.dis_thr and reports the range it used. Requires obsm/spatial coordinates and an LR table in uns/; do not use it on dissociated data without coordinates (use communication.lr_interaction_scoring), and treat significant pairs as co-localisation evidence, not proof of signalling.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI with obsm/spatial coordinates and an LR table in uns/.

method.description: Scoring backend. spatialdm_z is the default; commot requires commot.dis_thr; squidpy_ligrec is a non-spatial comparator.

resource.description: Name of the ligand-receptor table in uns/ (ligand, receptor and complex subunits).

layer.description: Expression layer scored as supplied; singlet applies no further normalisation.

n_perm.description: Permutations for permutation p-values; the smallest reportable p-value is 1/n_perm.

fdr_threshold.description: Benjamini-Hochberg q-value cut-off for calling significant pairs.

weights.description: Spatial weights for spatialdm and liana_morans.

n_neighbors.description: Restrict to this many nearest neighbours per spot; null keeps the weight-based graph.

rbf_length_scale.description: Radial basis length scale in coordinate units; SpatialDM only.

weight_cutoff.description: Zero radial basis weights below this value; SpatialDM only.

commot.description: COMMOT options, used only when method is commot.

dis_thr.description: Hard signalling range in coordinate units; required with commot.

cost_type.description: Distance cost: Euclidean or squared Euclidean.

eps_p.description: Entropic regularisation of the transport coupling, in cost units.

rho.description: Marginal penalty of the unbalanced transport problem.

nitermax.description: Maximum solver iterations per LR pair.

heteromeric_rule.description: Complex subunit aggregation rule; it changes scores materially.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for permutation nulls (spatialdm_perm, liana_morans, squidpy_ligrec).

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/spatial_lr/pairs. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_pairs_tested, n_significant, fdr_threshold and top_pairs (up to 10 rows with pair, score, pvalue, qvalue and range). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
